main.description: A reply to someone else's net.bisks.rateyourbuild.rating review. One record per (replier, reviewed site, review author) — replying again overwrites the previous reply in place, RateYourMusic-comment-thread style. Written and read by rateyourbuild (https://rateyourbuild.bisks.net).

subject.description: The bare name of the rated site — same value as the rating record's subject.

reviewer.description: DID of the account whose rating/review this is a reply to.

createdAt.description: When this reply was last written, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
